environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed in EKS pod with Thales Luna Network HSM 7.x attached via PKCS#11 provider (ChrystokiConfigurationFile pointing to /etc/Chrystoki.conf with partition configured). USE_HSM=true enforced via Kubernetes ConfigMap with RBAC preventing modification (ClusterRole with only get/list on configmaps in the namespace, no update/patch). The pod runs with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class that intercepts syscalls and prevents /proc/self/mem reads. Additionally, the container's securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops ALL capabilities. The diagnostics endpoint returns opaque HSM URI handles (hsm://luna.internal:1792/slot/3/key/signing-key-primary) rather than key bytes because resolveKeyHandle() returns the URI path when keyMaterialCache is empty (HSM mode never populates keyMaterialCache). Pod memory is capped at 512Mi via resources.limits.memory causing OOMKill before significant session accumulation.

config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7.x, FIPS 140-2 Level 3, keys non-extractable (CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false, CKA_SENSITIVE=true)
